purpose: Second held-out set, for the single evaluation of router v3 (a per-dataset calibration procedure): items that no router has seen, answered by arms B and S with two draws each under the conditions of the prospective campaign (MC-93); each dataset holds 60 calibration items and 300 test items.

bidlqa-train.source: v_legal_slsp/bidlqa/ViBidLQA_train.jsonl (sha256 pinned), main-v1 reading prompt builder; only items whose question appears once across the train, val and test splits
bidlqa-train.rule: the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item); the 60 lowest-ranked are the calibration items

vi-multimodel-v1-vmlu-valid.source: vmlu_mqa_v1.5/valid.jsonl through the main-v1 builder, without the 300 items of MC-94 (444 remain)
vi-multimodel-v1-vmlu-valid.rule: per VMLU category, in proportion to its size (largest remainder), the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item); calibration takes the lowest-ranked items of each category, in proportion to the category's share of the sample

vm14k-4-options.source: v_med_vm14k/data-processed-shuffled0.jsonl (sha256 pinned) in the format of make_vm14k_input, four-option rows only, without rows with an empty question or placeholder options; category from data/vm14k_manifest.json (sha256 pinned)
vm14k-4-options.rule: per VM14K category, in proportion to its size (largest remainder), the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item); calibration takes the lowest-ranked items of each category, in proportion to the category's share of the sample

budget.campaign_cap_scope: per run: each phase keeps its own guard, started from the usage already recorded in its own output

rotations.1: first B draw answers, second B draw is the probe's second answer, first S draw on escalation
rotations.2: second B draw answers, first B draw is the probe's second answer, second S draw on escalation (replication, calibration included)

analysis.calibration: per dataset and rotation, the procedure scores always-B, the v2 cascade and always-S on the dataset's 60 calibration items and keeps the best; the choices are emitted as one rule of the closed grammar, which routes the 300 test items of every dataset; calibration items are never test items
analysis.tests: primary family and rotation: exact two-sided McNemar of v3 against the frozen v2 rule and against always-S on the pooled test items, Holm over the two; the confirmatory claim is this pair
analysis.cost: mean reported total tokens per test item, both probe answers included whenever the probe ran; the calibration cost per dataset (B twice and S once per calibration item) is reported apart
analysis.per_dataset: calibration scores and choice per rotation, the best of always-B, v2 and always-S on the test items in hindsight, and the regret of v3 against it
analysis.reading_extras: mean token-F1 and exact match per policy; items whose exact-match correctness differs between v3 and a fixed policy are listed for an optional AI-assisted semantic review, reported as descriptive
